text: {"lessons":["Selling B, E, and C at gains felt good, but my purchase price and satisfaction are not reasons by themselves to sell; I should judge each position on its merits.","I should not hold a losing position merely to avoid realizing a loss, or keep treating each stock as a separate account; decisions should reflect my overall holdings and cash.","My account rose and then slipped despite months without trades, and past price changes do not predict what comes next; I should avoid reacting to short-term swings or trading just to feel in control."]}
